query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organizations WHERE id = 120001) as org_exists,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE id = 2580004) as user_exists,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_users WHERE organizationId = 120001 AND userId = 2580004) as user_in_org;
